fib: ______ is defined as the distribution of sand (0.05-2.0 mm), silt (0.002-0.05mm), and clay (< 0.002mm) in soil.
texture
Texture Soil texture is defined as the distribution of sand (0.05-2.0 mm), silt (0.002-0.05mm), and clay (< 0.002mm) in soil.

Bioavailability processes
Bioavailability processes are the biological, chemical and physical processes that result in an organism being exposed to a contaminant present in the soil.
______ is responsible for protecting earth from harmful ultraviolet rays.
Ozone layer
Ozone Layer Depletion Ozone layer is responsible for protecting earth from harmful ultraviolet rays.

Soil

Soil salinization
